credential_nft.aleo.notes: v1, @noupgrade, single-record mint to caller (employer only). Superseded by credential_nft_v2.aleo which emits dual records so workers see credentials in their own wallet.

credential_nft_v2.aleo.notes: @admin, dual-record mint but NO on-chain authorization check on mint — permissionless, anyone could fabricate credentials. Superseded by credential_nft_v3.aleo which adds employer_agreement_v4::assert_employer_authorized + two pnw_name_registry ownership checks on every mint.

credential_nft_v3.aleo.notes: @admin, dual-record mint + hard on-chain authorization. mint_credential_nft takes 13 inputs including agreement_id + parties_key + employer_name_hash + worker_name_hash as auth material. Cross-program calls: pnw_name_registry_v2::assert_is_owner(employer_name_hash, self.caller), pnw_name_registry_v2::assert_is_owner(worker_name_hash, worker_addr), and employer_agreement_v4::assert_employer_authorized (parties commitment + ACTIVE status). Unauthorized mints revert at the contract level. Depends on the 2026-04-12 upgrade of employer_agreement_v4.aleo (tx at15424d6swsselyrkmdv7gr2d2cql93rqjq0y3j25v3fzf4p79asgqzssqch) which added assert_employer_authorized.
